description: Daily Suez Canal transit counts and dwell/idle times derived from AIS, from the Asian Development Bank dataset on HDX. The file in this source ends in April 2021, so the tool reports that end date; it has no live convoy queue. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: How many most recent days, 1 to 60 (default 7)
